'''Peter Skalicky''' (25 April 1941 – 3 November 2025) was an Austrian academic who was the rector of [[TU Wien]].

==Life and career==
Skalicky was born in [[Berlin]], [[Nazi Germany|Germany]], on 25 April 1941. After taking his A-levels in [[Vienna]], he studied [[physics]] at TU Wien. He wrote his [[PhD]] thesis on [[X-ray|Röntgen]] [[topography]]. In 1973, he became an associate professor.<ref name="Skalicky ">{{cite web|url=http://www.tuwien.ac.at/fileadmin/t/tuwien/fotos/pa/3.pdf|title=Prof. Dr. Peter Skalicky |accessdate=17 May 2011}}</ref> Since 1979, he has been a full professor of [[applied physics]].<ref name="Skalicky " /> From 1991 until 2011, he was rector of TU Wien.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bmwf.gv.at/startseite/mini_menue/presse_und_news/news_details/cHash/69d5a9e7691a20b818c543ffc42242d1/article/vier-starke-stimmen-fuer-die-forschung-beatrix-karl-praesentiert-ihre-vier-nominierungen-fuer-de/|title=Vier starke Stimmen für die Forschung – Beatrix Karl präsentiert ihre vier Nominierungen für den Forschungsrat|language=German|accessdate=17 May 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100913043022/http://www.bmwf.gv.at/startseite/mini_menue/presse_und_news/news_details/cHash/69d5a9e7691a20b818c543ffc42242d1/article/vier-starke-stimmen-fuer-die-forschung-beatrix-karl-praesentiert-ihre-vier-nominierungen-fuer-de/|archive-date=13 September 2010|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was followed in this function by [[Sabine Seidler]].

Skalicky was vice chair on the Council of the [[University of Leoben]].<ref>{{cite web|title=University Management|url=http://unileoben.ac.at/en/3030/|publisher=University of Leoben|accessdate=17 April 2017}}</ref>

He received an Officier dans [[l'Ordre national du mérite]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://worldforum.hct.ac.ae/regional-forums/2010-europe/participants/prof-peter-skalicky/|title=Prof. Peter Skalicky|publisher=World Forum|accessdate=17 May 2011|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120324054115/http://worldforum.hct.ac.ae/regional-forums/2010-europe/participants/prof-peter-skalicky/|archivedate=24 March 2012}}</ref> from the French ambassador. He was a member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].

Skalicky died on 3 November 2025, at the age of 84.<ref>{{cite web |title=Peter Skalicky – ein Nachruf |url=https://www.tuwien.at/tu-wien/aktuelles/news/news/peter-skalicky-ein-nachruf |website=TU Wien |access-date=6 November 2025 |date=6 November 2025}}</ref>
